data.name: Sacred Animal Focus
data.description: A scarab stalker can select from the bee, bull, cat, cow, crocodile, falcon, ibis, jackal, kite, leopard, lion, ram, scarab beetle, scorpion, sha, snake, and uraeus animal foci, rather than the foci normally available to a hunter.
